description: This file contains the implementation of the SystemConfigurationService interface, providing methods to manage system configuration data, including retrieving configuration by key. It extends a generic service implementation and uses dependency injection for the DAO layer.

classes.name: SystemConfigurationServiceImpl
classes.description: A service implementation class for system configuration management, providing methods to access and manipulate system configuration data.

methods.name: SystemConfigurationServiceImpl
methods.description: Constructor that injects the SystemConfigurationDao dependency.

methods.name: getByKey
methods.description: Retrieves a SystemConfiguration object based on the provided key; throws ServiceException if an error occurs.
